// PROBE: the MobilePolicyCard `getStatusConfig` shape — a local status→label/colour
// map that reads whatever key it is handed and falls back to green. This is the
// second of the two shapes that multiplied before lib/wallet/policy-status-view.ts
// existed. The display-single-source guard must flag it.
const STATUS_CONFIG = {
    active: { label: 'Ενεργό', className: 'bg-green-100 text-green-700' },
    expiring_soon: { label: 'Λήγει σύντομα', className: 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-700' },
    expired: { label: 'Έληξε', className: 'bg-red-100 text-red-700' },
}

export function StatusBadge({ status }: { status: string }) {
    const config = STATUS_CONFIG[status as keyof typeof STATUS_CONFIG] ?? STATUS_CONFIG.active
    return <span className={config.className}>{config.label}</span>
}
